svg.aria-label: Terminal output of npx samesight audit --project upstream --sync-config upstream/sync-config.planted.yaml --runs 3 --time-limit 60 --seed 1842: audit reports devices holding rows RLS refuses their users. FAILED: 1 failing, 3 warnings (100s)
svg.title: samesight audit catching a planted sync config leak (dark)
svg.desc:
$ npx samesight audit --project upstream --sync-config upstream/sync-config.planted.yaml --runs 3 --time-limit 60 --seed 1842
Sync config ok streams: 1 stream, 2 queries, sending lists, todos
Database catalog ok row level security: on for all 2 synced tables ok policies: lists: "owned lists" (ALL to authenticated) ok policies: todos: "todos in owned lists" (ALL to authenticated) ok anon: no policy lets anon read a synced table ok roles: anon and authenticated bypass no RLS, inherit no other role and own no policy table ok views: no view anon or authenticated can select reads a protected table past RLS ok publication: powersync publishes every synced table (FOR ALL TABLES) ok user metadata: no RLS policy or stream query reads user_metadata, which users can set on themselves
PowerSync ok powersync version: 1.27.2, started by audit for this run (pinned; at least the 1.20.1 security floor)
Claims ok claims: no rule reads a token claim other than the user id
Differential (4 users, 1 datasets) FAIL differential: devices and RLS disagree (seed 1842, shrunk 5 times to 3 rows; shrinking stopped at the time limit): leak: u1 received lists 5a3e5a3e-e925… (owner_id u0); RLS returns no such row for this user sent by stream user_data, queries[0] SELECT * FROM lists refused by policy "owned lists" on lists likely fix queries[0] has no owner_id filter, which policy "owned lists" has; add WHERE owner_id = auth.user_id() (2 more row blocks, for u2 and u3, left out of this capture) replay samesight-verify audit --project upstream --sync-config upstream/sync-config.planted.yaml --runs 3 --time-limit 60 --seed 1842
(Coverage and Write path sections left out of this capture)
FAILED: 1 failing, 3 warnings (100s)
svg.text: examples/audit-todolist
$ npx samesight audit --project upstream --sync-config upstream/sync-config.planted.yaml --runs 3 \
--time-limit 60 --seed 1842
ok streams: 1 stream, 2 queries, sending lists, todos
ok row level security: on for all 2 synced tables
ok policies: lists: "owned lists" (ALL to authenticated)
ok policies: todos: "todos in owned lists" (ALL to authenticated)
ok anon: no policy lets anon read a synced table
ok roles: anon and authenticated bypass no RLS, inherit no other role and own no policy table
ok views: no view anon or authenticated can select reads a protected table past RLS
ok publication: powersync publishes every synced table (FOR ALL TABLES)
ok user metadata: no RLS policy or stream query reads user_metadata, which users can set on themselves
ok powersync version: 1.27.2, started by audit for this run (pinned; at least the 1.20.1 security floor)
ok claims: no rule reads a token claim other than the user id
FAIL differential: devices and RLS disagree (seed 1842, shrunk 5 times to 3 rows; shrinking stopped at the
time limit):
leak: u1 received lists 5a3e5a3e-e925… (owner_id u0); RLS returns no such row for this user
sent by stream user_data, queries[0]
SELECT * FROM lists
refused by policy "owned lists" on lists
likely fix queries[0] has no owner_id filter, which policy "owned lists" has; add
WHERE owner_id = auth.user_id()
